crossRefs.note: Joshua said to all the people, “Behold, this stone shall be a witness against us, for it has heard all Yahweh’s words…
He took his relatives with him, and pursued him seven days’ journey. He overtook him in the mountain of Gilead.
From Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the valley, even to Gilead, there…
To the Reubenites and to the Gadites I gave from Gilead even to the valley of the Arnon, the middle of the valley, and…
With him the Reubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond the Jordan eastward…

people.name: Laban
people.line: Brother of Rebekah; father of Leah and Rachel

people.name: Ramoth
people.line: City of refuge east of the Jordan

translations.web: Laban said, “This heap is witness between me and you today.” Therefore it was named Galeed
translations.bsb: Then Laban declared, “This mound is a witness between you and me this day.” Therefore the place was called Galeed.
translations.kjv: And Laban said, This heap is a witness between me and thee this day. Therefore was the name of it called Galeed;
